content.what_it_is: MATLAB 2-D spectrum scatter-plot function. It converts theta from radians to degrees for horizontal positions, plots frequency versus direction colored by Spectrum_Energy, applies fixed direction/frequency/color ranges and reference lines at theta_mean/fp, saves an overview PNG, narrows the frequency range to 0.09-0.11 for a detail PNG, then closes all figures (L1-L28).
entities: function Plot_2D and inputs theta, freq, Spectrum_Energy, theta_mean, Coherent_Percentage, and fp declared at L1-L2
colorbar handle h defined at L9

equations.ref: scatter with theta converted to degrees

calls: set and gca at L7 and L10
saveas, gcf, fullfile, and num2str at L22 and L27
unresolved: Definite unit-label mismatch across L4-L5/L13/L20 and L16: theta positions, limits, reference line, and ticks are in degrees, but the x-axis label says radians.

theta, freq, and Spectrum_Energy lengths/shapes are not validated before scatter at L4; theta_mean is assumed degrees while theta is assumed radians, an asymmetric interface documented only by arithmetic.
The fixed caxis [0,4] at L11 can clip all larger/negative energy values without reporting their range.
Both saves at L22 and L27 assume a pre-existing figures directory; the function does not create or check it.

The colorbar reports density per radian at L18 while the horizontal axis is displayed in degrees. The values may remain per-radian densities, but the mixed presentation is not explained and can mislead visual integration over the degree axis.
